source_extracts.label: FedEx alcohol shipping
quotes: An adult signature is required for final delivery.

For U.S. delivered shipments, an Adult Signature Required (ASR) service is mandatory. The recipient must be at least 21 years of age, present government-issued photo identification, and sign for the shipment.

If the recipient is unavailable, FedEx may reattempt the delivery. Since alcohol shipments require an adult signature, the recipient must be present, provide proof of age, and sign for the delivery before the package can be delivered.
FedEx currently only permits wine shipments under licensee-to-consumer agreements; beer and spirits require licensee-to-licensee.
Individuals (consumers) cannot ship alcohol via FedEx.

source_extracts.label: UPS wine shipping
quotes: All wine shipments must be made using the UPS Delivery Confirmation Adult Signature Required service, requiring the signature of an adult 21 years of age or older upon delivery.
UPS only accepts packages containing wine from shippers who are licensed under applicable law and who have signed and entered into a contract with UPS for the transportation of wine.

When picking up the package, the recipient is required to present a government-issued photo ID, such as driver's license, passport, military ID, or permanent resident card, to verify that the recipient is 21 years of age or older. If the recipient fails or refuses to present proper identification, the wine shipment is considered undeliverable and returned to the shipper.
